chapter: Postwar: Chicago, Vinson, Hines and Cootie
title: Hines's unreleased record date with three violins
summary: The band made a good record date with violins that was never issued, which Gus later asked Hines about.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: No. Well, you know, Earl Hines made some records. I was in the band when he made some records, too. And these records never came up. When I first joined him band.
Yeah, those are the -- that's the famous session no one ever found.
No, he had three violin players in the band on this session. See, and it was a good date.
And I don't know what happened. They never did come out, they never did come out.
They didn't get the money. I even asked Earl about that the last time I saw him.
I should think that was like around '48.
Could have been, could have been.
